title: ‘Food insecurity, poor sleep linked’
summary: Older Filipino adults with insufficient access to nutritious food are sleeping poorly, according to local and foreign experts.

blocks.text: Studying almost 3,600 people aged 60 and older nationwide, researchers found that “the prevalence of food insecurity was 13 percent among community-dwelling older Filipinos and the prevalence of sleep deficiency was 80 percent.”
MANILA, Philippines — Older Filipino adults with insufficient access to nutritious food are sleeping poorly, according to local and foreign experts.
Food insecurity is linked to poor sleep as it mainly increased the chances of depression and physical weakness , they said.
Depressive symptoms and frailty among older Filipinos living independently were two plausible explanations for sleep deficiency when suffering from food insecurity, authors noted.

“Tackling depression and frailty may help improve sleep among older adults who experience food insecurity. Supporting mental health, preventing frailty and ensuring food security could therefore play a big role in helping older people live healthier and more restful lives,” researchers said.
